thread:
lena (product): @morgan noted a fintech prospect (LedgerWave) asking for a blended pricing proposal: reserved capacity + per-token smoothing + a small cushion for burst. they want predictable monthly spend and the ability to burst 2x for short periods. can we triage this?

morgan-sales: yep, they’re in POC. asking for an offer that maps to their card-authorization workloads (spiky, many short calls). CFO wants committed credits + lower per-token for committed usage.

akash-pm: key questions: 1) what do we mean by "cushion" (tokens vs capacity)? 2) expected burst duration and frequency? 3) is SLA uplift required?

morgan-sales: they phrased cushion as "burst bucket" in tokens for the month. bursts are usually few minutes but can be multiple times/day during settlement windows. they’ll commit to 500k tokens/mo for 12 months if we give a ~20% discount on committed tier and allow bursts up to 1M tokens total per month billed at blended rate.

rachel-finance: a blended rate for committed + burst is doable but complicates invoicing and revenue recognition. need to define how we meter burst vs baseline and whether unused reserved credits roll.

sam-support: from ops: if we allow bursts that exceed reserved GPU capacity we need clear fallback. do they accept graceful degradation (lower QPS) or automatic fallback to cheaper model variant?

lena (product): propose triage options: A) Simple credits: commit credits (500k) at discounted per-token; burst tokens billed at higher overage rate. B) Blended cap: commit + burst pooled and a single monthly blended rate (simpler for customer, harder for billing). C) Reserved capacity + burst bucket: provision reserved GPU slots for baseline and a technical burst bucket that triggers fallback rules.

morgan-sales: customer prefers B (blended) for predictability. they said legal wants a single line-item charge.

rachel-finance: B increases revenue forecasting friction. we can accept as a pilot if we limit it to 3 customers and require explicit usage profiles. need product to define launch criteria and tracking metrics (token separation, unit economics delta, bad debt risk).

evan-legal: also need to confirm contract language around overages and termination. blended rate can obscure overage liability; require clear definitions for "burst window" and a cap.

akash-pm: suggested launch criteria: 1) defined metering logic (how we attribute tokens to commit vs burst), 2) billing integration design doc, 3) telemetry to show delta in cost per token vs baseline across 3 pilot customers, 4) fallback policy documented and tested.

lena (product): rough implementation effort: billing + ledger changes (3 wks), runtime routing for reserved vs burst (2 wks), console UI for contract view (1 wk), docs + legal + pilot checklist (1 wk) => ~7 wks cross-team.

rachel-finance: add compliance check for revenue recognition; we’ll need finance + legal signoff before pilot.

sam-support: ops action: identify safe fallback models for fintech workloads and test with synthetic spiky traffic. i can run load tests next Tue.

morgan-sales: action: i’ll get their usage CSVs and a POI for expected spike windows.

lena (product): decision: move to pilot-track with product priority P2. product to create a spec doc w/ metering pseudo-code and rollout plan. please add list of required telemetry (per-token cost, error-rate during bursts, fallback trigger counts).

deploy-bot: scheduled: new thread created in #product by lena at 1768801234

lena (product): thanks all. i’ll create the initial spec and link here. deadline: draft spec by EOD next Monday. if anyone has objections to pilot scope, flag now.

morgan-sales: sounds good. :thumbsup:

rachel-finance: noted. will prep revenue recognition checklist.

sam-support: will post load test plan once i have the usage CSV.

ev an-legal: will review contract template, expect comments next Wed.

lena (product): tagging action items: @morgan get usage CSVs, @sam run load tests, @rachel finance checklist, @evan legal language. moving to backlog under ticket PROD-8452.
